title: quercus pedunculiflora var. pinnatipartita
intro: Quercus pedunculiflora var. pinnatipartita, commonly known as Korean oak or white oak, is a plant species known for its unique characteristics and medicinal properties. This plant is used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Quercus pedunculiflora var. pinnatipartita include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit cytotoxic effects against certain pathogens. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
